events.title: 퀸스 파크 레인저스 sign striker Mark Falco from 레인저스 for £350,000.
에버턴 and 레인저스 draw 2–2 in the Dubai Champions Cup , with the Scottish club winning on penalties.

Eight football hooligans, all either 맨체스터 유나이티드 or 웨스트햄 유나이티드 supporters, receive prison sentences totalling 51 years at Chelmsford Crown Court after being found guilty of public order offences on a Sealink ferry bound for Amsterdam on 8 August 1986. Meanwhile, 첼시 look to the future with the acquisition of Jersey -born defender Graeme Le Saux , 19.
Portugal 's FC 포르투 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Uruguay 's Peñarol in extra-time by a score of 2–1. The winning goal is scored by Rabah Madjer .
Nigel Clough scores a hat-trick in less than five minutes as 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 4–0 in the First Division game at the City Ground .
맨체스터 유나이티드 pay £900,000 for 노리치 시티 central defender Steve Bruce , with his old club using £580,000 of the transfer to sign Robert Fleck from 레인저스.
Boxing Day sees 노팅엄 포리스트 win 2–0 at Highbury to overtake 아스널 into second place, while in a London derby 윔블던 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 2–1, and David Pleat's tenure as 레스터 시티 manager starts with defeat to 본머스 .
퀸스 파크 레인저스 defender Terry Fenwick completes a £550,000 transfer to 토트넘 홋스퍼.

The year draws to a close with 리버풀 holding a commanding ten-point lead over second-placed 노팅엄 포리스트. 왓퍼드 have slipped to the foot of the table, level on points with 찰턴 애슬레틱. 포츠머스 occupy the final automatic relegation place. Graeme Souness signs 애스턴 빌라 midfielder Mark Walters for 레인저스 for £550,000 in the latest of several moves for English players. In the Second Division, 미들즈브러 lead with a one-point margin over 브래드퍼드 시티. A four-point margin separates their nearest six challengers – 애스턴 빌라, 크리스털 팰리스, 밀월 , 헐 시티, 맨체스터 시티 and 입스위치 타운.
